science_vegetable: Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea
narrative_prose: Hector stood atop the Basalt_Spire_Ridge, squinting through the searing wind at the blazing amber corona of the magnetosphere overhead. The oscillating shriek of the Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea drowned out all other noise, leaving only the tang of ionized ozone and metallic grit on his tongue. He had to firmly DEFEND the grounding array from the mounting static pressure, then quickly ATTRACT the roaming arc-flashes to the brass capacitor banks before they could overload the system. As the final induction coil began to CONSUME the raw kinetic energy, he grinned into the gale and thrust the warm copper calibration baton directly into Kaio's waiting hands.

horizon_goals.immediate_session_goal: Secure the primary grounding array before the magnetic shear intensifies
horizon_goals.mid_term_milestone: Stabilize the enclave's energy grid against the chaotic magnetosphere
horizon_goals.campaign_arc_climax: Master the raw kinetic forces of the exoplanet sanctuary

active_location.macro_silhouette: The Basalt Spire Ridge loomed as a jagged precipice of darkened rock, fully exposed to the violent atmospheric forces above. Arcing currents of raw lightning danced across the peaks, illuminating the sprawling ferrofluid sea below. It was a perilous vantage point where raw kinetic potential constantly threatened to overwhelm any fragile instrumentation.
